title: Plan X: AI Music Beat-Sync MV
summary: Analyze song → storyboard → visual generation → beat-sync editing → publish
scenario: For pairing an AI-generated song with a visual MV or beat-sync short for Douyin, Bilibili or music platforms.

steps.title: Analyze the song
steps.detail: After generating or choosing a track, use beat-detection or the waveform to mark BPM, downbeats and the climax section so the whole edit knows where the beats land. Verses and choruses should get very different visual density.
steps.tips: Let a beat-detection tool place the markers — faster and more reliable than by ear.

steps.title: Storyboard
steps.detail: Write the storyboard from the lyrics' meaning and mood: each section gets its own density, the climax gets fast cuts and striking visuals, and ideally each line of lyrics becomes one shot so the sync stays clean.
steps.tips: Make the number of shots match the number of downbeats — beat-sync is just cuts landing on beats.

steps.title: Visual generation
steps.detail: Generate keyframes in a locked art style with Midjourney (reusing the same style prompt and character reference), then run image-to-video in Runway or Kling for motion; loopable shots give you flexible length to cover the beats.
steps.tips: Lock the character and scene design before generating video — that's how character stays consistent across shots.

steps.title: Beat-sync editing
steps.detail: Snap clips to the beat with cuts on downbeats and 1-2 second cuts in the climax, adding zooms and flash frames for punch. Use Descript's waveform snapping to auto-align, then fine-tune by hand.
steps.tips: Get cuts frame-accurate; rough-cut first, then polish beat by beat — speed invites sloppy sync.

steps.title: Publish
steps.detail: Export vertical 9:16 and horizontal 16:9 versions with lyric captions and hashtags; launch on one primary platform first and only spread once the data looks good.
steps.tips: Put the song title and style keywords in the title for music-platform and search traffic.

pitfalls.title: Inconsistent art style
pitfalls.detail: Shots that jump styles break the film's cohesion; lock the style keywords first.

pitfalls.title: Off-beat cuts
pitfalls.detail: A cut half a beat late reads as amateur; invest the time to fine-tune.

pitfalls.title: Drifting character design
pitfalls.detail: The protagonist changing looks across shots ruins the MV; fix a reference image before generating.
